title: Wireless Game Controller for PC and Most Consoles, Dual Vibration, 6-Axis Gyro
description:
A full-size wireless gamepad with a familiar layout that pairs over Bluetooth with PCs, tablets, smartphones and most current consoles. Twin vibration motors and a motion sensor add feedback in racing and action games.
• Bluetooth 5.0 with up to 10 m range, or play wired with the included 1 m USB-C cable
• Built-in 600 mAh battery for about 12 hours of play; full charge in about 2 hours
• Dual vibration motors, 6-axis gyroscope and turbo button
• Textured grips and analogue triggers; weight 225 g
• Works with PCs, most smartphones and tablets, and most consoles that accept standard Bluetooth controllers

title: Wired USB Gamepad for PC and Laptop, Plug and Play, Dual Vibration, 1.8 m Cable
description:
A no-fuss wired controller for PC gaming: plug it into a free USB port and it is ready to go, with no batteries to charge. The long cable reaches comfortably from desk to sofa.
• Plug and play on PCs and laptops; mode switch on the back for wider game support
• Two 360° analogue sticks, D-pad and pressure-sensitive triggers
• Dual vibration motors for in-game feedback
• Braided 1.8 m USB-A cable
• Size 15.5 × 10.5 × 6 cm; weight 210 g

title: Telescopic Mobile Game Controller for Most Smartphones, Bluetooth, USB-C Charging
description:
Turns your phone into a handheld console. The spring-loaded grip stretches to hold phones from 4.7 to 6.9 inches, with proper sticks, buttons and triggers on both sides, ideal for cloud gaming and games with controller support.
• Fits most smartphones with 4.7–6.9 in screens (up to 17.5 cm long); slim cases can stay on
• Bluetooth 5.0 connection for most smartphones and tablets with game controller support
• Two analogue sticks, D-pad, shoulder buttons and analogue triggers
• 500 mAh battery for about 15 hours of play; USB-C charging cable included
• Folds to 18 × 9.5 × 4 cm for your bag; weight 190 g

title: Over-Ear Gaming Headset with Flexible Mic, 3.5 mm Jack, 50 mm Drivers, LED Light
description:
A comfortable over-ear headset for long sessions on PCs, consoles, laptops and phones. Large 50 mm drivers bring out footsteps and explosions, and the bendable boom mic keeps team chat clear.
• 50 mm drivers, 20 Hz–20 kHz frequency response
• Flexible omnidirectional microphone; in-line volume wheel and mic mute switch
• Soft protein-leather ear cushions and adjustable padded headband
• 3.5 mm 4-pole jack plus Y-splitter for PCs with separate mic and audio ports; the USB plug powers the LED lights only
• Cable length 2.2 m; weight 310 g

title: Wireless Gaming Headset, 2.4 GHz Low Latency and Bluetooth, 30-Hour Battery
description:
Cut the cable without adding lag: the USB dongle gives a stable 2.4 GHz link for gaming on PCs and most consoles, while Bluetooth mode connects to phones, tablets and laptops.
• 2.4 GHz wireless via USB-C dongle (USB-A adapter included), up to 12 m range
• Bluetooth 5.3 for smartphones, tablets and laptops
• Detachable noise-reducing microphone with mute button on the earcup
• 1,000 mAh battery for about 30 hours per charge; USB-C charging cable included
• 40 mm drivers and memory-foam ear cushions; folds flat; weight 270 g

title: USB Gaming Headset with 7.1 Virtual Surround Sound and RGB Earcups
description:
A plug-and-play USB headset with a built-in sound chip, so no separate sound card is needed. Virtual 7.1 surround helps you place footsteps and engines around you in shooters and racing games.
• USB-A connection; stereo works plug and play, and downloadable PC software adds 7.1 surround and light control
• 50 mm drivers with deep, punchy bass
• Flip-up boom microphone that mutes when raised
• Breathable mesh ear cushions and self-adjusting suspension headband
• 2.1 m braided cable; weight 320 g

title: 60% Compact Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, 61 Keys, Hot-Swappable Switches, RGB
description:
A space-saving 60% layout that keeps the keys you use most and frees up room for wide mouse movements. Hot-swappable sockets let you change switches without soldering.
• 61 keys, US QWERTY layout, double-shot PBT keycaps; arrows and F-keys on the Fn layer
• Hot-swappable sockets for 3- and 5-pin mechanical switches; keycap and switch puller included
• Per-key RGB backlight with 20 preset effects
• Detachable USB-C cable (1.5 m) and full N-key rollover
• Size 29.5 × 10.3 × 3.8 cm; weight 580 g

title: Wired RGB Gaming Mouse, Up to 7200 DPI, 7 Programmable Buttons
description:
An ergonomic right-handed gaming mouse with a fast optical sensor and side buttons you can assign to reloads, macros or shortcuts. The rainbow lighting can be switched off for a darker desk.
• Optical sensor with 6 DPI steps from 800 to 7,200 and 1,000 Hz polling rate
• 7 buttons including 2 thumb buttons and a DPI switch; remapping via downloadable PC software
• Main switches rated for 10 million clicks
• 1.8 m braided cable and smooth PTFE feet
• Size 12.6 × 7.2 × 4 cm; weight 105 g

title: Mechanical Gaming Keyboard and Mouse Set, Full Size, RGB Backlight, Wired
description:
A matching full-size mechanical keyboard and 6-button mouse that set up a complete gaming desk in one go. Clicky blue switches give crisp feedback with every keystroke.
• 104-key full-size US QWERTY layout with blue mechanical switches and N-key rollover
• RGB backlight with 18 effects and adjustable brightness; floating keycaps are easy to clean
• Mouse with 4 DPI steps up to 6,400 and RGB light ring
• Aluminium top plate and fold-out feet
• USB-A plugs with 1.6 m braided cables; keyboard 44 × 13.5 × 3.6 cm

title: Ergonomic Gaming Chair with Headrest and Lumbar Cushion, 155° Recline
description:
A racing-style chair with a high backrest, removable headrest pillow and lumbar cushion for comfortable support through long gaming or work sessions.
• PU leather cover over high-density foam; seat width 52 cm, backrest height 80 cm
• Backrest reclines from 90° to 155°, with lockable rocking function
• Height-adjustable seat on a class 4 gas lift; linked armrests fold up
• Steel frame and nylon five-star base with 60 mm casters; max load 150 kg
• Self-assembly in about 20 minutes; tools included

title: Gaming Desk 120 × 60 cm with Carbon Fibre Texture, Cup Holder and Headset Hook
description:
A sturdy Z-frame desk with space for a monitor, keyboard and speakers, plus handy extras that keep drinks and headphones off the desktop.
• Desktop 120 × 60 cm, height 75 cm; MDF top with carbon fibre-look laminate
• Powder-coated steel Z-frame with adjustable feet for uneven floors
• Clip-on cup holder and headset hook included
• Two cable grommets and a rear cable tray keep wires tidy
• Max load 80 kg; self-assembly, tools included

title: Dual Charging Stand for Wireless Controllers with USB-C Port, LED Indicators
description:
Keeps two controllers charged and tidy between sessions. Each cradle has a USB-C connector, so it suits most wireless controllers that charge via USB-C.
• Charges two controllers at the same time; about 2.5 hours for a full charge
• LED indicator per slot: red while charging, green when full
• Powered via the included 1 m USB cable from a console, PC or any 5 V USB adapter (adapter not included)
• Protection against overcharging, overheating and short circuits
• Non-slip base; size 14 × 8.5 × 5 cm

title: Headset Stand with RGB Light Base and 2 USB Ports, Aluminium Arm
description:
Gives your headset a proper place on the desk instead of the corner of the monitor. The base adds two handy USB ports and a soft ring of light.
• Aluminium arm with a soft silicone rest that protects the headband
• RGB light ring with 9 modes; touch button to change or switch off
• 2 × USB-A 2.0 ports for data and charging small devices (5 V), connected to your PC by a 1.5 m USB cable
• Weighted non-slip base; height 27 cm
• Fits most over-ear gaming headsets and headphones

title: Padded Travel Bag for Game Consoles, Controllers and Accessories
description:
A padded shoulder bag that carries a home console and its extras to a friend's place or on holiday. Movable dividers keep the console, controllers, cables and games apart.
• Main compartment 40 × 30 × 12 cm fits most full-size and slim consoles
• 10 mm foam padding on all sides; water-repellent polyester outer
• Movable hook-and-loop dividers, mesh cable pockets and a front zip pocket for game cases
• Padded carry handle and detachable shoulder strap
• Weight 850 g

title: Hard Shell Carrying Case for Controllers, Water-Resistant, Pick-and-Pluck Foam
description:
A tough, lockable case that protects controllers and their cables in a backpack or suitcase. The pre-cut foam can be shaped to fit almost any controller or small accessory.
• Impact-resistant polypropylene shell with rubber seal and pressure-release valve
• Pick-and-pluck foam insert; inner size 28 × 20 × 9 cm
• Holds two standard controllers plus cables, or one handheld console
• Two snap latches with padlock holes (padlock not included)
• Outer size 33 × 26 × 11 cm; weight 1.2 kg

title: VR Headset for Smartphones 4.7–6.8 in, Adjustable Lenses, with Bluetooth Remote
description:
An easy way to enjoy 3D films, 360° videos and VR apps with the phone you already have. Slide the phone into the front tray, set the lenses and the soft strap, and you are ready.
• Fits most smartphones with 4.7–6.8 in screens
• Adjustable focus and lens distance; resin lenses with about 100° field of view
• Breathable face foam, three-way adjustable head strap and room for most glasses
• Bluetooth remote with joystick for menus and simple games (2 × AAA batteries, not included)
• Recommended for ages 12+; take a short break every 30 minutes

title: Disposable VR Eye Masks, 100 Pack, Breathable Covers for Shared Headsets
description:
Single-use fabric covers that sit between your face and the headset foam, keeping it cleaner when a VR headset is shared at home, at parties or at events.
• 100 individually wrapped masks
• Soft, breathable non-woven fabric with pre-cut eye openings
• Elastic band fits most standalone and PC VR headsets
• One size, 23 × 9 cm
• Use once, then dispose of with household waste

title: XXL Gaming Mouse Pad 90 × 40 cm, Stitched Edges, Non-Slip Rubber Base
description:
A desk-sized mouse pad that fits your keyboard and mouse together, with plenty of room for full-arm swipes at low sensitivity. The smooth cloth surface glides evenly with optical and laser sensors.
• Size 90 × 40 cm, 4 mm thick
• Micro-weave cloth surface balanced for speed and control
• Anti-fray stitched edges and natural rubber base that stays in place
• Water-resistant coating; wipe clean with a damp cloth
• Ships rolled; lies flat after a few hours

title: Silicone Thumb Grip Caps for Controllers, 8 Pieces, Two Heights
description:
Soft, textured caps that slip over analogue sticks for extra grip and finer aim. The set mixes tall and low caps so you can find what suits your play style.
• 8 caps: 4 tall concave caps (+6 mm) and 4 low convex caps (+2 mm)
• Soft silicone with an anti-slip texture; washable with water
• Fits most standard analogue sticks on console and PC controllers
• Push on and pull off without tools
• Small storage pouch included

title: Phone Cooling Fan for Mobile Gaming, Semiconductor Cooler with Clip, USB-C
description:
A clip-on cooler that draws heat away from the back of your phone during long gaming sessions, helping to keep frame rates steady. The spring clamp holds most phones, even with a slim case.
• Semiconductor cooling plate with a quiet 7-blade fan
• Spring clamp fits phones 6.5–9 cm wide
• Powered via the included 1 m USB-C cable; use a 5 V / 2 A USB adapter or power bank (not included)
• RGB light ring that can be switched off
• Size 6.8 × 6.6 × 3.2 cm; weight 75 g
